retrieval_scope: all dev questions in each existing corpus, pure dense L2; application domain routing disabled
selection: All answer/flag_conflict cases from the previously committed quality_sample.json; targeted diagnostic sample, not an accuracy estimate
controls: Existing unchanged indexes, same query vector for independent K queries, same application generate method and model; no rerank, keyword search, gold routing or context truncation
generation_order: Rotate K order by question index to reduce systematic request-order effects; one generation per condition, no stability estimate
metrics: evidence-unit coverage at 80% normalized source-span overlap
decision: Do not change application default from a single case. Review both corpora, omissions, noise, token growth and targeted answers first. Held-out test remains unused.
